Thermo Scientific www.thermofisher.com Wilkins Chalgren Anaerobe Broth (Dehydrated)  EN REF CM0643B & CM0643R ## Intended Use Wilkins Chalgren Anaerobe Agar (CM0643B/R) is a medium for the growth of anaerobes and recommended for antimicrobial susceptibility testing. The devices are for professional use only, are not automated, nor are they companion diagnostics. ## Summary and Explanation Wilkins-Chalgren Anaerobe Broth supports the luxuriant growth of anaerobic organisms. It is derived from Wilkins Chalgren Agar CM0619B. Where studies on antimicrobial susceptibilities are to be made in both broth and agar, this medium is found to be of particular value. ## Principle of Method Wilkins Chalgren Anaerobe Broth includes yeast extract to supply vitamins and other growth factors such as purines and pyrimidines, that are necessary for good growth of *Peptostreptococcus anaerobius* and *Bacteroides melaninogenicus*. Arginine is added to ensure sufficient amino-acid is available for the growth of *Eubacterium lentum*. Pyruvate is present as an energy source for asaccharolytic cocci such as *Veillonella*. It also acts similarly to catalase and degrades traces of hydrogen peroxide, which may be produced by the action of molecular oxygen on medium constituents and interfere with the metabolism of anaerobes. Haemin is found to be essential for the growth of *Bacteroides* species and menadione for *Bacteroides melaninogenicus*. Peptones derived from the single protein sources casein and gelatin are used to improve standardisation of the medium. The early heavy growth that is usual may reflect the absence of Eh-reducing substances that can be inhibitory to some organisms. ## Typical Formula

CM0643R: 2.5kg of Wilkins Chalgren Anaerobe Broth. 500g of dehydrated Wilkins Chalgren Anaerobe Broth yields approximately 15.2L after reconstitution. ## Materials Required but Not Supplied • Inoculating loops, swabs, collection containers. • Incubators. • Quality control organisms. • Suitable final containers. ## Storage • Store product in its original packaging between 10°C and 30°C. • Keep container tightly closed. • The product may be used until the expiry date stated on the label. • Protect from moisture. • Store away from light. • Allow reconstituted product to equilibrate to room temperature before use. • Once reconstituted, store media between 2°C and 8°C and keep away from light. ## Warnings and Precautions • For in vitro diagnostic use only. • For professional use only. • Inspect the product packaging before first use.
